name: agent_browser
description: Browser automation agent — navigate, click, type, extract content, screenshot. Merged concepts from browser-use (107k⭐) and nanobrowser (13k⭐). Requires Playwright + Chromium.
author: GitHub browser-use + nanobrowser + QClaw 改造

invocationCommands.description: Navigate browser to a URL. Params: url (string), new_tab (bool, default false), timeout (int, default 30s)
Get all interactive elements (links, buttons, inputs) on the current page with their indices for click/type actions
Click an interactive element by its index from get_page_state. Params: index (int)
Type text into an input element identified by index. Params: index (int), text (string)
Extract visible text content from the current page. Params: query (string, natural-language description of what to extract)
Execute a high-level task (navigate + observe + act loop). Params: task (string), max_steps (int, default 10). Note: full autonomy requires LLM integration
invocationCommands.example: {"tool_name": "execute_task", "task": "search Google for 'weather today' and get the result"}

invocationCommands.description: Capture a screenshot of the current page. Params: full_page (bool, default false)
